verdict.rationale: Chroma Cloud is explicitly described as a managed, serverless offering with usage-based unit pricing (e.g., $0.03 per fork, pay only for incremental storage), contrasting with fixed-cluster provisioning, and community users corroborate a straightforward, reasonable pricing calculator and cost savings. Missing for 10: a full breakdown of all per-unit costs (compute/query pricing beyond forking/storage) and independent hands-on cost verification beyond anecdotal praise.
